title: IronClaw 1.0 separates agent decisions from actions behind one safety checkpoint
friendlyTitle: IronClaw 1.0 adds one safety gate for every agent action
summary: NEAR AI released IronClaw 1.0 across the command line, web, Slack and Telegram. Its architecture routes actions through a central guard, checkpoints state for resumption and shares memory and safety rules across channels; its benchmark claims use the same DeepSeek V4 Flash base model across compared harnesses.
friendlySummary: IronClaw now works across the web, terminal, Slack and Telegram with shared memory. It checks sensitive actions in one place and can continue a task after an interruption.
whyItMatters: Persistent agents need consistent approval, secret handling and recovery more than another chat surface. A single action gate and resumable state offer a useful design pattern for teams evaluating always-on assistants, though the vendor’s leaderboard claims still merit independent testing.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This design can make always-on assistants easier to control and less likely to lose work. Teams should still test the product with their own tasks and security rules.
